case.subject: Marie Hunter, owner/president of KRG Oil Company
case.problem: Analyzing the cost-benefit of customizing fuel storage tanks for niche customers was manual, time-consuming, and lacked a scalable growth strategy.
case.workflow: The AI agent ingests company data to crunch financial numbers and analyze potential business modifications. Instead of just assessing costs, it autonomously generated a strategic growth plan, including a proposal to upsell a new product line of tanks with additional service offerings.
case.result: The agent provided a concrete business blueprint that transformed the firm's strategic direction, acting as a force multiplier for the owner by handling both operational email tasks and complex growth analysis.
case.result_basis: Reported in a Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses program report, sourced via independent interview.
case.measurement_context: The case highlights a qualitative shift in strategic planning and workload management for a small family-owned business, rather than a raw percentage uplift.
case.source_quote: Rather than analyzing the cost of customizing a few fuel storage tanks for select customers, the agent delivered an ambitious blueprint for a new business.
case.limitation: The agent's strategic plans are subject to human evaluation and execution; it functions as an advisor rather than an autonomous corporate decision-maker.
case.listener_action: Identify one area of your business where you currently perform 'manual number crunching' and see if an agent can synthesize your data into a strategic growth scenario.
case.availability: The agent was custom-developed for KRG Oil Company; similar functionality is accessible via modern AI agent platforms.

case.subject: RBC Wealth Management
case.problem: Financial advisors were spending over an hour manually gathering and synthesizing CRM data to prepare for individual client meetings.
case.workflow: The AI agent accesses the advisor's Salesforce CRM data in real-time, autonomously synthesizing relevant client information, account history, and market context into a pre-meeting briefing.
case.result: Meeting preparation time was reduced from more than one hour to less than one minute per client.
case.result_basis: Vendor-reported case study; referenced in Salesforce Agentforce ecosystem documentation.
case.measurement_context: A direct comparison of time-to-task completion for a high-volume, repeatable workflow (meeting prep).
case.source_quote: Meeting prep that once took more than an hour now takes less than a minute.
case.limitation: The accuracy of the briefing depends entirely on the quality and cleanliness of the underlying CRM data accessed by the agent.
case.listener_action: Measure the time your team spends preparing for standard recurring meetings and trial an automated briefing agent to see if it provides equivalent context.
case.availability: Available as a standard job-ready agent within the Salesforce Agentforce platform.
